qualifier: monocyte and macrophage trafficking (CCR2/CX3CR1 axis)
name: Chemokine receptor-directed monocyte and macrophage migration
rationale: All members concern chemokines, their receptors or leukocyte chemotaxis/migration, centred on monocyte and macrophage recruitment (CCR2/CX3CR1 modules, monocyte differentiation and aggregation, monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis regulation), which separates it from confusables focused on lymphocyte homing, dendritic/T cell migration, lymphoid organ development or inflammatory monocyte activation.

qualifier: cytosolic DNA sensing
name: IRF3-mediated type I interferon induction via cytosolic DNA sensing
rationale: All members describe innate antiviral induction of type I interferon and interferon-stimulated output (IRF3 activation, IP-10, response to virus), and the cytosolic DNA-sensing arm distinguishes it from confusables built on RIG-I/MDA5 and dsRNA sensing.

core: Intracellular calcium store release and cytosolic calcium clearance
qualifier: ryanodine-sensitive, skeletal muscle
name: Ryanodine-sensitive ER calcium release and cytosolic calcium clearance
rationale: All members regulate the cytosolic calcium level through release from or return to the ER/SR store (ryanodine channel, caffeine response, Na/Ca exchange, cytosol-to-ER transport), distinguished from confusables on store-operated calcium entry and cardiac contraction by its ryanodine/skeletal-muscle release and calcium-lowering members.

core: Regulation of fatty acid uptake and beta-oxidation
qualifier: negative
name: Negative regulation of fatty acid uptake and beta-oxidation
rationale: All three members restrain fatty acid import/transport or its mitochondrial beta-oxidation, unlike confusables about lipid droplets, triglyceride storage, glucose import or carnitine-driven promotion of oxidation.

qualifier: left-right axis asymmetry of mesoderm and gut
name: Gastrulation germ layer formation and left-right asymmetry
rationale: All members concern early embryonic germ-layer (mesendoderm) specification, gastrulation movements, Nodal/pluripotency control and left-right patterning of lateral mesoderm, heart tube and gut, which separates it from confusables on later heart-field development and planar-polarity convergent extension.

qualifier: dendritic spine remodelling with long-term potentiation/depression
name: Dendritic spine remodelling and long-term synaptic plasticity
rationale: All members regulate dendrite and spine morphogenesis/maintenance, postsynaptic actin and density organization, or long-term synaptic plasticity and memory (including reelin and NMDAR-RAC1 input), distinguished from confusables on BDNF/TrkB, synapse assembly and adhesion, and generic Rho GTPase filopodia control.

qualifier: collagen (GPVI) and ADP (P2Y) receptor triggers, degranulation
name: Collagen- and ADP-triggered platelet activation, aggregation and degranulation
rationale: All members describe platelet adhesion, activation, aggregation, degranulation or coagulation, and the collagen/GPVI, GPIb-IX-V and ADP P2Y receptor triggers plus degranulation distinguish it from confusables on VWF variants, thrombin/thromboxane/prostacyclin GPCRs and integrin cytoskeletal adhesion.

core: Innate pattern-recognition receptor signalling to NF-kappaB and stress kinases
qualifier: TLR and NOD1/2 adaptors acting through TAK1/IKK to NF-kappaB and JNK/p38
name: TLR/NOD-receptor signalling through TAK1 to NF-kappaB and JNK
rationale: All members concern innate receptor (TLR, NOD1/2, Dectin-1, inflammasome) signalling via IRAK/TRAF6/TAK1/IKK to NF-kappaB and JNK/p38 activation, distinguished from confusables on TNFR/CD40 NF-kappaB control, NF-kappaB immunodeficiency diseases and negative stress-kinase regulation.

qualifier: from mesenchymal progenitors
name: Osteoblast differentiation and bone formation from mesenchymal progenitors
rationale: All members concern mesenchymal progenitor commitment to osteoblasts, RUNX2/Wnt/BMP control of osteoblast proliferation and differentiation, and ossification of bone, cartilage and tendon matrix, distinguished from confusables on chondrocyte maturation, joint morphogenesis, bone mineralization and generic collagen/ECM secretion.

core: Cyclin-CDK–RB1 control of the G1/S transition
qualifier: cancer defects including p16INK4A and RB1 loss
name: Cyclin-CDK–RB1 control of G1/S and its cancer defects
rationale: All members describe cyclin D/E-CDK, CKI and RB1/E2F control of G1/S entry or its disruption in cancer (defective p16INK4A, RB1 mutants, CDK4/6 inhibitors), distinguished from confusables on p14ARF/p53, G2/M checkpoints and E2F target transcription.

qualifier: Cdc20-to-Cdh1 switch and late mitosis/early G1 substrates
name: APC/C-Cdh1-mediated proteolysis at mitotic exit and early G1
rationale: All members concern regulation of the anaphase-promoting complex ubiquitin ligase and its substrate degradation during late anaphase into G1, with the Cdc20-to-Cdh1 switch and Cdh1 targets distinguishing it from confusables on APC/C:Cdc20 securin/cyclin B degradation, APC/C phosphorylation and Emi1 inhibition.

core: Galactose catabolism via the Leloir pathway
qualifier: inherited galactosemias
name: Leloir pathway galactose catabolism and its inherited defects
rationale: All members describe Leloir-pathway galactose breakdown or galactosemias caused by defects in its enzymes (GALK1, GALT, GALE, GALM), unlike confusables on fructose, pentose and glucuronate metabolism.

qualifier: full receptor-to-TCF span including oncogenic pathway mutants
name: Canonical Wnt/beta-catenin signalling from receptor to TCF target genes
rationale: All members concern canonical Wnt/beta-catenin signalling, from FZD/LRP/DVL and the AXIN destruction complex to TCF/LEF transcription, including its oncogenic mutants and inhibitors, distinguished from confusables on non-canonical/calcium Wnt and Wnt secretion, Notch signalling, and a narrower set of destruction-complex mutants.

qualifier: NMDA receptor calcium influx through CaMK to CREB in potentiation and memory
name: NMDA receptor–CaMK–CREB signalling in potentiation and memory
rationale: All members describe NMDA/AMPA glutamate receptor activation and the downstream calcium-CaMK/AMPK/Ras signalling to CREB and NPAS4 transcription underlying LTP and memory, distinguished from confusables on AMPA/kainate receptor trafficking, dendritic structural plasticity and cAMP adenylate-cyclase modules.

core: Ion channel control of epithelial fluid and pH sensing
qualifier: acid/pH-sensing channels and CFTR-dependent water transport
name: Acid/pH-sensing channels and CFTR-dependent epithelial fluid transport
rationale: All members concern membrane channel-mediated ion and water flux, split between pH/sour sensing (TRP, TALK K+ channels, acidic pH response) and CFTR/anion-driven epithelial water and pancreatic secretion, distinguished from confusables on apical protein trafficking, secretion physiology and SLC bicarbonate/anion exchangers.

core: Rab GTPase regulation in vesicle docking
qualifier: prenylation, GEF/GAP cycling and SNARE assembly
name: Rab GTPase prenylation and cycling in vesicle docking
rationale: All members concern small GTPase (Rab, ARF) regulation by geranylgeranylation, GEFs and GAPs and its role in vesicle docking, SNARE assembly and receptor delivery, distinguished from confusables on Golgi organization, vesicle tethering/targeting and Rho/Ral GTPase activity.

qualifier: converging on RAC1 activation
name: Axon guidance receptor signalling via RAC1 activation
rationale: All three members describe guidance-cue receptor signalling (ephrin, DCC attraction) that activates RAC1, unlike confusables on netrin repulsion, ROBO-SLIT, EPHA growth-cone collapse and DSCAM self-avoidance.

qualifier: glycinergic inhibitory transmission
name: Glycinergic inhibitory transmission and motor coordination behaviour
rationale: All members concern inhibitory glycinergic neurotransmission (including SLC6A5 hyperekplexia) or the motor coordination and locomotor reflexes and cerebellar structures it supports, distinguished from confusables on exploratory/psychomotor behaviours, proprioception and neural RNA-binding modules.

qualifier: type 1 and type 2 promoters (tRNA genes)
name: RNA polymerase III transcription from type 1 and 2 promoters
rationale: All members describe the initiation, elongation and termination of RNA polymerase III transcription at gene-internal type 1/2 promoters such as tRNA genes, distinguished from confusables on type 3 snRNA promoters and RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription and processing.

qualifier: synthesis from cholesterol, enterohepatic recycling and receptor signalling
name: Bile acid synthesis, enterohepatic recycling and signalling
rationale: All members concern bile acid synthesis from cholesterol (7alpha/24/27-hydroxylation routes, CYP8B1, CYP27A1 defect), bile acid transport and recycling, and LXR/bile acid signalling, distinguished from confusables on peroxisomal oxidation, ABC-transporter cholestasis and intestinal lipid absorption, and CYP spastic paraplegias.

qualifier: vasopressin-regulated renal water reabsorption and glycerol/urea transport
name: Vasopressin–aquaporin water reabsorption and aquaglyceroporin solute transport
rationale: All members concern aquaporin-mediated water, glycerol and urea transport and its vasopressin control of renal water reabsorption and urine volume, distinguished from confusables on sodium/chloride transport, osmotic stress and the renin-angiotensin system.

qualifier: histone methyltransferase and CHD/NuRD remodeller complexes
name: Histone methyltransferase and CHD-remodeller transcriptional coregulator complexes
rationale: All members describe histone lysine/arginine methyltransferase complexes (WDR5/MLL4, PRMTs) or CHD/NuRD remodellers acting as transcription-factor coregulators, distinguished from confusables on DNA methylation, PRC2 heterochromatin and histone deacetylation/demethylation.

qualifier: gamma-glutamyl cycle synthesis, turnover and inherited enzyme defects
name: Glutathione synthesis, gamma-glutamyl cycle turnover and inherited defects
rationale: All members concern glutathione synthesis, transport, catabolism and recycling through the gamma-glutamyl cycle and inherited defects of its enzymes (GCLC, GSS, GGT1, OPLAH), distinguished from confusables on amino acid catabolism, glycine conjugation and glutamate/cysteine homeostasis.

core: Neuropeptide G protein-coupled signalling in behaviour
qualifier: opioid signalling and drug reward responses
name: Neuropeptide and opioid signalling in drug reward behaviour
rationale: All members concern neuropeptide/opioid GPCR signalling, dense-core vesicle release and DARPP-32, or behavioural responses to addictive drugs and reward conditioning, distinguished from confusables on dopamine receptor signalling and neuropeptide-driven social, feeding and sleep behaviours.

core: Synaptic transmission and dendritic spine maintenance
qualifier: excitatory and inhibitory transmission enhancement
name: Dendritic spine maintenance and excitatory–inhibitory synaptic transmission
rationale: All members concern neuron-neuron synaptic function, namely dendritic spine and projection maintenance, postsynaptic organization and glutamatergic/GABAergic transmission with their behavioural readouts (prepulse inhibition, nonassociative learning), distinguished from confusables on locomotor behaviour, reelin/LTP structural plasticity and AMPA receptor clustering.
